notes.title: [Don’t FOOL ME, Beauties!] Into the Hot Springs With the Beauties—Now on Sale!
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Don’t FOOL ME, Beauties! dev team! 💖

💦 Today again, the cold-hearted beauties won’t stop teasing you… 💦
But this time, you’re not at the hotel—you’re on a hot springs trip! 🌴🔥
Steam rising, hearts pounding… can you handle the heat?

From Ga-eun’s tsundere pride, to Ah-young’s mischievous pranks,
Bit-na’s dazzling charisma, and Ji-woo’s otaku charm—
the hot springs bring out a whole new side of these unforgettable ladies. 👙💕

💖 And here’s the best part—Don’t FOOL ME, Beauties! is now on special discount! 💖
If it’s already on your wishlist, now’s the perfect time to grab it.
👉 Steam store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3516180/Dont_FOOL_ME_Beauties/ 

Don’t miss out—you might regret it later… 🛍️🔥

Thank you as always for all your love and support! 💕
